Each arm dir has runs/runs.csv and runs/qNN.rK.out/.err, cluster.log, engine-.cnN.log, quent/ (raw), cnlog.txt/json (cnlog_extract.py: fragments, declared cardinalities, nixl transmits, OOM reschedules, futile aborts, fix2/fix4 counters), quent.txt/json (quent_bp.py), compare.txt (oracle).

The user also ran this branch on a 2x RTX PRO 6000 box (2 CNs, NIXL): /tmp/claude-1002/-home-prestouser-aocsa-sirius/25f3e903-c551-4a98-b7fc-a6e0ed53ade6/scratchpad/demoplus/reference-2cn-rtxpro6000.md, where q05 q08 q09 q18 fail with OOM and q17 q21 fail (cause not shown); the user wants to know WHY those six fail with more than one CN and what is needed, noting that feat/pin-table-cn (tables pinned in GPU memory) ran most of them. Tools: /tmp/claude-1002/-home-prestouser-aocsa-sirius/25f3e903-c551-4a98-b7fc-a6e0ed53ade6/scratchpad/perf/sf1000/cnlog_extract.py, quent_bp.py, card_compare.py, results_table.py, /tmp/claude-1002/-home-prestouser-aocsa-sirius/25f3e903-c551-4a98-b7fc-a6e0ed53ade6/scratchpad/perf/quent_summary.py. The SF1000 report from yesterday: /home/prestouser/.claude/plans/starrocks-sirius-perf/sf1000-planning-cardinality-backpressure.md; fix specs: /tmp/claude-1002/-home-prestouser-aocsa-sirius/25f3e903-c551-4a98-b7fc-a6e0ed53ade6/scratchpad/fix/designs/*-SPEC.md.
Rules: do not modify any source tree, do not start clusters or GPU jobs, write only under /tmp/claude-1002/-home-prestouser-aocsa-sirius/25f3e903-c551-4a98-b7fc-a6e0ed53ade6/scratchpad/demoplus/agent-notes/. Measured vs inference, every number with its file.

Refute this finding from the measurements and, where it names a mechanism, from the source: {
 "id": "fusion-is-1cn-only",
 "claim": "Fusion is inert with more than one CN, so it cannot be the answer to 'why do the six fail at 2/4 CNs'. The 4-CN arms logged fusion_mode=Leaf on all four CNs and 0 'fused sender fragment' lines (and 0 'skipped' lines) in both dp-cn4/cluster.log and dp-cn4-six-stg48/cluster.log — as the spec states, every shuffle sink there has 4 destinations and every gather receiver expects 4 senders, so the leaf rule declines everything by construction. At 2 or 4 CNs the six therefore run the pre-fix shape (lineitem in its own fragment, shipped whole through the staging arena or parked), which is what exhausts the 16 GiB arena on GB200 (five of six pass only with a 48 GiB arena; q09 exhausts even that with 95 leases holding 50.6 GB) and what the RTX PRO 6000 2-CN run hit as OOM on q05/q08/q09/q18. The 1-CN memory profile (q05 at the 100 GiB GPU cap plus ~107 GB host) also says the fused shape itself would not fit a 96 GB GPU. What the six need on N>1 CNs is a multi-CN mechanism (bounded/streamed exchange consumption or spillable parked repositories), not fusion; the pinned feat/pin-table-cn path avoided the problem by not shipping the scan output at all.",
 "evidence": [
  "/tmp/claude-1002/-home-prestouser-aocsa-sirius/25f3e903-c551-4a98-b7fc-a6e0ed53ade6/scratchpad/demoplus/arms/dp-cn4/cluster.log (4x 'fusion_mode=Leaf'; grep 'fused sender fragment' = 0; 'fragment fusion skipped' = 0) and /tmp/claude-1002/-home-prestouser-aocsa-sirius/25f3e903-c551-4a98-b7fc-a6e0ed53ade6/scratchpad/demoplus/arms/dp-cn4-six-stg48/cluster.log (0 / 0)",
  "/tmp/claude-1002/-home-prestouser-aocsa-sirius/25f3e903-c551-4a98-b7fc-a6e0ed53ade6/scratchpad/fix/designs/fragment-fusion-SPEC.md section 7 ('4 CNs: every shuffle sink has 4 destinations ... nothing fuses by construction') citing perf/survey/plan-summary-4cn.txt",
  "/tmp/claude-1002/-home-prestouser-aocsa-sirius/25f3e903-c551-4a98-b7fc-a6e0ed53ade6/scratchpad/demoplus/arms/dp-cn4-six-stg48/cnlog.txt (q05/q08/q17/q18/q21 pass, q09 fail) and runs/q09.r0.err",
  "/tmp/claude-1002/-home-prestouser-aocsa-sirius/25f3e903-c551-4a98-b7fc-a6e0ed53ade6/scratchpad/demoplus/reference-2cn-rtxpro6000.md (q05 q08 q09 q18 fail OOM, q17 q21 fail)"
 ],
 "confidence": "medium",
 "impact": "Frames the user's multi-CN question: the demo-plus branch fixes the six on 1 CN only; the >1-CN failures are the unfused exchange path and need a different fix. The RTX-box cause attribution is inference from the GB200 4-CN error text and the 1-CN memory profile, not from RTX logs (none available here).",
 "task": "six-on-1cn"
}

`HOST_MEM` is a lazily-grown **ceiling**, not a reservation. Measured CN host RSS at rest is
1.0–1.5 GiB. It yields so page cache can hold the parquet:

- SF100 / SF500: 4×160 = 640 GiB committed; leftover cache many times the dataset.
- SF1000: 4×112 = 448 GiB committed; leftover **~393 GiB** against a 380 GiB f64 tree (≈1.03×).

- SF3000 / SF10000: the dataset is larger than CPU LPDDR. `HOST_MEM=16GiB` is intentional.
  Scans miss cache and hit `/raid` NVMe. That is the only legal split; it is not a claim the
  suite will finish.

**Do not use** `STAGING ≈ 96 GiB × (SF/500) / N`. That formula is retired (A100 campaign floor;
it underestimated even there). It would ask for 144 GiB of arena per CN at SF3000, which does
not fit 184 GiB of HBM. The table above **caps occupancy** and grows staging only until the
pool would drop below ~110 GiB.

Evidence root: `scratchpad/demoplus/arms/` (arms `dp-cn4`, `dp-cn1-six`, `dp-cn4-six-stg48`, `dp-cn4-q09-stg72`), yesterday's bundle `scratchpad/perf/sf1000/`, the report `~/.claude/plans/starrocks-sirius-perf/sf1000-planning-cardinality-backpressure.md`, source in the read-only worktree `/home/prestouser/aocsa/sirius-stacks-wt/demo-plus` (`W/`) and the `feat/pin-table-cn` checkout at `/home/prestouser/aocsa/sirius` (`C/`). ## 1. One sentence

At N > 1 the FE hash-partitions the whole lineitem projection across the CNs (cardinality-1 plans, C1/P1); the CN exchange is receiver-first and park-then-export, so every CN must hold its own parked share **plus** the inbound frames from the other N-1 CNs before the join fragment may start; the inbound frames live in the fixed staging arena until then, and the arena throws instead of waiting (B6). With the default 16 GiB arena all six die of arena exhaustion at 4 CNs; with 48 GiB five pass and q09 still exhausts; with 72 GiB q09 moves to a pool OOM at the receiver. On a 96 GB GPU at 2 CNs the per-CN parked share alone exceeds any pool for four of the six, and the other two exhaust the arena.
